title: Older 2BR Cottage Foothill Discount
address: 1512 Foothill Blvd, Rear Cottage, San Luis Obispo, CA 93405
description_and_lease_text: Older 1960s compact 2BR rear cottage 1.1 miles from Cal Poly. Priced well below typical Foothill market because kitchen is dated, floors are original linoleum, there is no A/C or dishwasher, and laundry is shared with front house. Water and trash included; street parking only. Subleasing allowed. In-person tour required before any deposit.
